citations.caveat_finding: Neither realization theorem holds against an adversary that can modify or spoof network traffic. Theorem 1 assumes an adversary 'who cannot forge or modify network traffic'; Theorem 2 allows arbitrary delay and dropping but 'cannot modify or spoof'. The restriction is stated in the theorems and not in the functionality, so a reader looking only at the box will not see it.
